newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plunge 4.49 pct on Moody's report.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plunge 4.49 pct on Moody's report.

text.p: Pakistani stocks plunged 4.49 percent at close on Thursday on selling pressure triggered by reports that Moody's has downgraded Pakistan's credit ratings, brokers said.

"Yesterday's gains have been wiped off. Moody's adverse report dampened the sentiment," dealer Khalid Waheed said. "There was heavy selling by speculators and the index will slip 25 to 40 points further before we see any fresh buying coming in." The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 70.89 points to end at 1,509.35. Losers led gainers 171 to 34. Hub Power fell 2.60 rupees to 34.65. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
